decisions.subject: Production pipeline

options_considered.label: Hybrid
options_considered.reason: Preserves the supplied talking-head as anchor while adding designed evidence layers.

options_considered.label: Talking Head
options_considered.reason: Fits the source but its beta pipeline is less explicit about full-screen support scenes.
options_considered.rejected_because: The requested reference treatment relies on evidence cards and mixed support layers.

options_considered.label: Animation
options_considered.reason: Would displace the authentic source speaker.

decisions.reason: The requested treatment is source-led with purposeful support visuals.

decisions.subject: Composition runtime

options_considered.label: Remotion
options_considered.reason: Best fit for frame-accurate source video, subtitle timing, and React overlays in one pass.

options_considered.label: HyperFrames
options_considered.reason: Strong for HTML/GSAP typography.
options_considered.rejected_because: More complex than needed for a 45-second source-led edit and less aligned with the existing caption timeline.

options_considered.label: FFmpeg
options_considered.reason: Reliable for encoding and simple overlays.
options_considered.rejected_because: Insufficiently expressive for the requested animated editorial hierarchy.

decisions.reason: It preserves source synchronization while supporting the reference-style typography and evidence cards.

decisions.subject: Composition authoring mode

options_considered.label: Customized template
options_considered.reason: Extends the stable presenter composition with a new editorial overlay system.

options_considered.label: Atelier
options_considered.reason: Would maximize uniqueness.
options_considered.rejected_because: The brief asks for an existing reference grammar and the low-resolution source benefits from restrained customization.

decisions.reason: A controlled extension gives the requested look without unnecessary production risk.

decisions.subject: Background music

options_considered.label: No music
options_considered.reason: Keeps the non-native English speech maximally intelligible and matches the restrained reference.

options_considered.label: Pixabay royalty-free music
options_considered.reason: Available at no API charge.
options_considered.rejected_because: Adds little value to this short cautionary explainer.

decisions.reason: Speech clarity is the audio priority.

decisions.subject: Human approval gates

options_considered.label: Full-run preauthorization
options_considered.reason: The user explicitly requested that no questions be asked throughout.

options_considered.label: Per-stage approval
options_considered.reason: Normal manifest policy.
options_considered.rejected_because: Contradicts the user's explicit no-questions instruction.

decisions.reason: The user's instruction is explicit full-run authorization within the requested scope.

decisions.subject: V3 editorial refinement

options_considered.label: Source-visible overlays
options_considered.reason: Preserves presenter continuity while improving explanatory density.

options_considered.label: Full black cards
options_considered.reason: High contrast but visually disconnects the presenter.
options_considered.rejected_because: The user asked to optimize all visible issues except source quality.

decisions.reason: Unifies the visual system, enlarges information and reduces disruptive black-screen time.

decisions.subject: Transition sound layer

options_considered.label: Local subtle cues
options_considered.reason: Adds structure without external APIs or masking speech.

options_considered.label: API-generated music
options_considered.reason: Could add energy.
options_considered.rejected_because: No external API was needed and speech clarity remains the priority.

decisions.reason: Four quiet transition cues add polish at zero API cost.

decisions.subject: Full-screen readability layer

options_considered.label: Direct content overlay
options_considered.reason: Preserves the original image brightness and makes the graphics feel native to the footage.

options_considered.label: Full-screen translucent shade
options_considered.reason: Guarantees contrast but visually recreates a black chapter page.
options_considered.rejected_because: The user explicitly preferred direct content display.

decisions.reason: Only text shadows and local card surfaces remain; no full-frame darkening is applied.

decisions.subject: Editorial card outer container

options_considered.label: Content card only
options_considered.reason: Removes the unintended translucent outer plate while preserving the designed content card.

options_considered.label: Shadowed outer wrapper
options_considered.reason: Creates an unnecessary second visual layer.
options_considered.rejected_because: The user identified it as an unwanted transparent layer.

decisions.reason: All editorial wrapper shadows, rounding and clipping were disabled.

decisions.subject: Information card position selection

options_considered.label: Face-safe automatic placement
options_considered.reason: Uses the full overlay interval to select a stable safe zone and supports center fallback.

options_considered.label: Fixed side presets
options_considered.reason: Simple but cannot react to speaker position.
options_considered.rejected_because: The user requested automatic left/right recognition with center fallback.

decisions.reason: Prefer the configured side when safe, switch sides if occupied, otherwise choose the safer of top-center and bottom-center.
